scope_note: Second layer (DB→DLR sell-out) CY2025. Networks: ITUK, UTI, IRELAND, IUK, GREECE. ITUK from dealer pivot (network + dealer grain). UTI from PartSales YTD. IRELAND / IUK / GREECE (and any other long CSV) from dealer_sellout_long_*. IUK ≠ ITUK; IRELAND ≠ IUK. AIM buckets: bvp | genuine_contested | genuine_only.
valuation_note: Sell-out reports are quantity only — no dealer EUR. ISZE-denominated value = reported qty × median CY2025 ISZE→DB unit price per PN (proxy for mix; not sell-out revenue). IUK is qty-only by design (no EUR chase). PNs with no billing price contribute qty but €0 to proxy totals. Billing rows use actual invoice EUR and GPS.
